title: O'Melveny Park – O’Melveny Park Trail Improvements (PRJ21740) (PRJ21980)
text:
O'Melveny Park – O’Melveny Park Trail Improvements (PRJ21740) (PRJ21980)
  Project – Commitment of Park Fees – Modification of the Scope of work –
  Categorical Exemption from the Provisions of the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section 15301(c) [Existing Highways
  and Streets, Sidewalks, Gutters, Bicycle and Pedestrian Trails, and Similar
  Facilities] and Section 15311 [Construction, or Placement of Minor Structures
  Accessory to (Appurtenant to) Existing Commercial, Industrial, or Institutional
  Facilities] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1, Class 1(3),
  Class 11(1) and Class 11(6) of City CEQA Guidelines
